subject: Constant entry
notes: kb/Work PB1229 (wave 1031 D). Both halves of SR6 are enforced: literal-1 (AS ZERO / SPACE / ALL "A", BindConstantStringLiteral, COBOL1547) and every literal of arithmetic-expression-1 — the figurative ZERO/ZEROS/ZEROES the token rewriter turns into ZERO_ARITH next to an arithmetic operator (`AS ZERO + 1`, `AS ZEROES * 3`, `AS 2 - (ZEROS)`, `AS -ZERO`) is refused by EvalArith (COBOL1547, negative constant-figurative-arith-operand); EvalArith used to return 0 for it. The directive twin (>>DEFINE / >>IF operands) was already barred by EvaluateDirectiveArithmetic (COBOL1619, §7.3.3 SR10). Editions: §13.10 is unchanged 2014->2023 (Annex E lists no constant-entry change); the 2002 band follows the row's earlier adjudication.
